BORN TO PLAY Paddle—Pink & Navy Stripe with Metallic Gold Detail TECH: 20mm thickness Japanese Toray T700 carbon fibre Thermoformed body Foam walls XGRIT surface for spin and control Extra long face and handle Advantages of a 20mm Paddle: Enhanced Control: The thicker core provides a larger sweet spot, making it more forgiving on off-center hits and improving your ability to control the ball. Improved Stability: A thicker paddle is more stable, reducing torquing (twisting) and providing a more consistent experience when blocking hard shots. Better Shock Absorption: The thicker core absorbs more of the ball's energy, reducing vibrations and providing a more comfortable and dampened feel. Softer Touch: Thick-core paddles offer a softer touch, which is beneficial for soft shots like resets and drop shots. Increased Power (for certain shots): While control is the primary advantage, some players find they can still generate power, especially with control-oriented shots, due to the unique feel of the thicker core. Who Benefits from a 20mm Paddle? Defensive Players: Players who focus on defense, blocking, and resetting the ball will benefit from the added control and stability. Players with a Soft Touch: If you prefer a softer feel and more control over your volleys and drops, a 20mm paddle is a good choice. Beginners and Intermediate Players: The larger sweet spot and stability make it a user-friendly option for those learning to play or wanting a forgiving paddle. BONUS: Two white indoor pickleballs included while supplies last. Note: Handle tape color may vary. Now shipping. Under review by USA Pickleball.
